crop.notes: The whole item 'McCoole and Allen. What the New York Clipper Says.' across two pieces.

ocr.notes: Readable with many small letter errors; a few phrases garbled ('successful culmination and prevent' lost).

title.suggested: New York Clipper on the McCoole-Allen Rematch

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted the New York Clipper's comments on the new match between Mike McCoole and Tom Allen, hoping the much-abused Allen would get the fair play denied him on Foster's Island.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'Daily Democrat. Monday Morning, July 26, 1869.' This is before the 1875 merger, so it is not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: The New York Clipper reported that a new match had been made between Allen and McCoole, expected to draw more attention than any American prize fight in years, after the disgraceful scenes at Foster's Island

notes: The Clipper describes Allen as the smaller, more skillful man against the much heavier McCoole, and says the chosen ground should give each man an equal number of friends.
